question: At RH of about 33% and 28 C, by how many percentage points did the share of coffee-ring deposits change when the magnetic field was applied?
expect: +40 points: 40.0% zero field to 80% with the field (Table 3)
rendered: At RH ≈ 33% and T = 28 °C, the share of coffee-ring deposits increased from 13.3% to 80%. The change is 80% - 13.3% = 66.7 percentage points.
